build.native: Both Rust SDKs use Bazel -c opt and SDK-scoped cross-crate ThinLTO; both C++ consumers Release -O3.
build.comparator: Pinned upstream release, opt-level=z, full LTO, one codegen unit. Bootstrap/workloads compiled with Hermes -O.
build.clock: Same high-resolution steady_clock __now() hook; full TS suite also uses __now().

benchmarkScript:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
cd /tmp/hermes-intl-extension
bootstrap="$PWD/$(rg '\.hbc$' /tmp/hermes-plural-magrinj-bytecode-path)"
run_variant() {
 case "$1" in
  before) taskset -c 0 /tmp/hermes-list-arguments-hires "$2" ;;
  after) taskset -c 0 /tmp/hermes-alias-independent-hires "$2" ;;
  magrinj) FORMATJS_BENCH_BOOTSTRAP="$bootstrap" taskset -c 0 /tmp/hi-host-optimized "$2" ;;
 esac
}
run_case() {
 local label="$1" workload="$2"
 for variant in $variants; do
  run_variant "$variant" "$workload" > "/tmp/hermes-alias-independent-${label:+$label-}$variant-$round.jsonl"
 done
}
for round in 1 2 3; do
 if [ "$round" = 2 ]; then variants='magrinj after before'; else variants='before after magrinj'; fi
 run_case '' /tmp/hermes-list-default-overlap.hbc
 run_case tag /tmp/hermes-canonical-control.hbc
 run_case size /tmp/hermes-list-size-control.hbc
 run_case locale /tmp/hermes-canonical-locale-control.hbc
done
for round in 1 2 3; do
 if [ "$round" = 2 ]; then variants='magrinj after before'; else variants='before after magrinj'; fi
 run_case constructor /tmp/hermes-list-constructor-control.hbc
 run_case relative /tmp/hermes-rtf-bridge-control.hbc
done
for round in 1 2 3; do
 if [ "$round" = 2 ]; then variants='after before'; else variants='before after'; fi
 run_case full /tmp/hermes-locale-inline-all-api.hbc
done

for round in 1 2 3; do
 if [ "$round" = 2 ]; then variants='magrinj after before'; else variants='before after magrinj'; fi
 run_case boundary /tmp/hermes-list-arguments-control.js
done

for round in 1 2 3; do
 if [ "$round" = 2 ]; then variants='after before'; else variants='before after'; fi
 run_case plural /tmp/hermes-plural-record-control.js
done

for round in 1 2 3; do
 if [ "$round" = 2 ]; then variants='magrinj after before'; else variants='before after magrinj'; fi
 run_case first-use /tmp/hermes-list-join-first-use-control.js
done

for round in 1 2 3; do
 if [ "$round" = 2 ]; then variants='magrinj after before'; else variants='before after magrinj'; fi
 run_case facade /tmp/hermes-locale-slot-control.js
done
profileScript:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
cd /tmp/hermes-intl-extension
sdk=/tmp/hermes-extension-sdk-alias-independent-hires
host=/tmp/hermes-alias-independent-hires
for smoke in "$sdk"/js/*-smoke.js; do
 case "$smoke" in *datetimeformat-smoke.js) "$host" /tmp/hermes-list-default-datetime-smoke.js ;; *) "$host" "$smoke" ;; esac
done
"$host" /tmp/hermes-locale-extension-sdk-check.js > /tmp/hermes-alias-independent-sdk-extension-check.json
for variant in before after; do
 if [ "$variant" = before ]; then host=/tmp/hermes-list-arguments-hires; else host=/tmp/hermes-alias-independent-hires; fi
 taskset -c 0 "$host" -sample-profiling=chrome -sample-profiling-freq=1000 -profiling-out="/tmp/hermes-alias-independent-$variant.cpuprofile" /tmp/hermes-locale-current-cold-profile.js > "/tmp/hermes-alias-independent-$variant-profile.log" 2>&1
 "$host" /tmp/hermes-benchmark-clock-check.js > "/tmp/hermes-alias-independent-clock-$variant.json"
done
for variant in before after; do
 if [ "$variant" = before ]; then host=/tmp/hermes-list-arguments-hires; else host=/tmp/hermes-alias-independent-hires; fi
 experiment=/tmp/hermes-alias-independent-hardware-$variant.er
 taskset -c 0 gprofng collect app -p off -h 'cycles~user=1~system=0,hi' -o "$experiment" "$host" /tmp/hermes-locale-current-cold-profile.js > /tmp/hermes-alias-independent-hardware-$variant.log 2>&1
 gprofng display text -functions "$experiment" > /tmp/hermes-alias-independent-hardware-$variant-functions.txt
 gprofng display text -header "$experiment" > /tmp/hermes-alias-independent-hardware-$variant-header.txt
done
bash /tmp/hermes-alias-independent-run.sh
order: Three CPU0-pinned rounds per workload; round2 reverses host order. Profiles run first. No builds or profiling during final timings. Identical frozen optimized bytecode on applicable hosts. Separate source controls remain diagnostics.
change: Read language-independent alias rules directly from their generated constant slice, avoiding dispatch through the large language match for constant und. All rules, ordering and matching unchanged. Per-language und lookup returns the same slice. No ABI or host adapter changes.

canonicalizationReferences.comparison: exact outputs; no skipped or normalized differences

conformance: All74 broad gates include native source/package APIs, typechecks, Hermes Test262 suites with existing exclusions, TS/Rust Locale conformance and pinned ICU4C/J/X canonical-private, constructor-option, collator, plural, list, relative-time and locale-formatting comparisons. Existing coercion order, aliases, retained instances and cache bounds unchanged. Strict Locale retains two pre-existing waived Realm failures.
